template: California Tenant Protection Act statewide rent cap (Civil Code 1947.12) does not govern this address because a local rule (r-D042-03) governs instead of it. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 (added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 290, Sec. 4 (SB 567)); as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
rewrite: California's statewide rent cap under the Tenant Protection Act (Civil Code 1947.12) does not apply to this address, because a local rule (r-D042-03) applies instead. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 (added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 290, Sec. 4 (SB 567)); as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
